app.name: Ufuq
app.tagline: Company management and employee operations in one system

state.session_required: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

state.success_detail: The change is saved and the data below is up to date.

showcase.modal_body: This is a reusable confirmation dialog.

error.not_found: The requested item was not found
error.account_locked: This account is temporarily locked. Try again later
error.account_not_activated: This account has not been activated yet
error.company_inactive: This company's account is not active
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again later
error.token_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired
error.password_policy_violation: This password does not meet the requirements
error.conflict: This action conflicts with the current state of the data
error.department_has_children: This department cannot be removed while it still contains sub-departments. Move or remove them first.
error.department_has_positions: This department cannot be removed while positions are still assigned to it. Reassign them first.
error.malformed_request: The request could not be understood
error.department_has_employees: This department cannot be removed while active employees are assigned to it. Move them to another department first.
error.employee_terminated: This employee's employment has ended, so their status cannot be changed here.
error.employee_not_active: Invitations can only be sent to active employees. Activate the employee first.
error.account_already_activated: This employee has already set a password, so there is no invitation to resend.
error.last_active_admin: This is the company's only active administrator. Give another employee the administrator role first.
error.mail_delivery_failed: The invitation email could not be sent. Try again in a few minutes.
error.already_checked_in: You have already checked in today. Check out when you finish.
error.not_checked_in: There is no check-in recorded for today. You can submit a correction request.
error.already_checked_out: You have already checked out today. Submit a correction request to change it.
error.non_working_day: Today is a rest day on your schedule. Confirm that you want to record attendance.
error.correction_window_closed: The correction window for this date has closed. Contact your administrator.
error.correction_not_pending: This request has already been decided, so it cannot be changed.
error.correction_already_pending: You already have a pending correction request for this date.
error.attendance_date_in_future: A correction can only be requested for a date that has passed.
error.invalid_status_transition: The task cannot move to that status from its current one.
error.task_has_open_items: Some checklist items are still open. Confirm to complete the task anyway.
error.goal_cancelled: This goal has been cancelled and can no longer be changed.
error.goal_progress_automatic: A task goal’s progress is calculated from its completed tasks. It cannot be entered by hand.
error.request_not_pending: This request has already been decided or cancelled.
error.request_self_review: You cannot approve or reject your own request. Another administrator must review it.
error.request_category_specialised: This kind of request is submitted from its own form.

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Everyone employed by the company, with their department, manager and sign-in account.
employees.empty_description: Add your first employee, then send an invitation so they can set a password.
employees.filtered_empty_description: Change or clear the filters to see more employees.
employees.search_placeholder: Search by name, employee ID or email
employees.email_helper: The employee signs in with this address and receives the invitation at it.
employees.work_schedule_helper: This employee's attendance is calculated from this schedule.
employees.no_schedules: Every employee needs a work schedule. Create one in settings, then come back to add employees.
employees.role_helper: Changing the role signs the employee out of every session.
employees.send_invitation_helper: The employee receives an email with a link to set their password.
employees.invitation_failed: The employee is saved, but the invitation email could not be delivered. Resend it from this profile.
employees.unsaved_changes: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
employees.manager_cycle: This choice would make the employee report to someone who reports to them.
employees.attendance_empty: Attendance recorded for this employee appears here.
employees.tasks_empty: Tasks assigned to this employee appear here.
employees.goals_empty: Goals set for this employee appear here, with their progress.
employees.salary_empty: This employee's salary and its change history appear here.
employees.requests_empty: Requests this employee submits appear here with their status.
employees.reports_empty: Monthly reports generated for this employee appear here.
employees.invitation_expired: The invitation link has expired. Resend it so the employee can set a password.
employees.invitation_not_sent: No invitation has been sent yet.
employees.deactivate_body: {name} will be signed out everywhere and will not be able to sign in. Employment, attendance and payroll history are kept.
employees.deactivate_reason_helper: Kept in the audit log with this change.
employees.activate_body: {name} will be able to sign in again. If they never set a password, a new invitation is sent.
employees.not_found: This employee does not exist, or is not available to you.
employees.history_empty: Every change to this employee record appears here, with who made it and when.

invitation.title: Set your password
invitation.description: Choose a password to activate your Ufuq account.
invitation.terms_label: I have read and accept the terms of use.
invitation.terms_required: Accept the terms of use to activate your account.
invitation.password_helper: At least {min} characters. Avoid a password you use anywhere else.
invitation.success_body: You can now sign in with your email address and the password you chose.
invitation.missing_token: Open the invitation link from your email again, or ask your administrator to resend it.
invitation.expired: Ask your administrator to resend the invitation.
invitation.policy_breached: This password is too common or has appeared in a data breach. Choose another.

invitation.subject: Your invitation to {company} on Ufuq
invitation.body: {company} has created your account on Ufuq. Set your password to activate it.
invitation.expiry: This link expires on {expiry}. After that, ask your administrator to resend it.
invitation.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

settings.company_description: The identity, timezone, currency and language every other module reads.
settings.departments_description: The organisational units employees are assigned to.
settings.schedules_description: Working days, hours, grace period and overtime rule. Attendance is calculated from these values.
settings.holidays_description: Company dates excluded from working days.
settings.name: Name
settings.logo_path_helper: Path to the stored logo file.
settings.timezone_helper: IANA identifier, for example Africa/Cairo. All attendance is calculated in this zone.
settings.fiscal_month_start_day_helper: Between 1 and 28, so the day exists in every month.
settings.delete_department_confirm: Remove "{name}"? Historical records keep pointing at it; it stops being offered for new assignments.
settings.is_default_helper: New employees are placed on the default schedule.
settings.grace_period_helper: Arriving within this many minutes of the start time does not count as late.
settings.half_day_threshold_helper: A day worked below this many hours counts as a half day.
settings.working_days_helper: Set every day of the week. Nothing in the system assumes a working week.
settings.no_departments_description: Departments group employees for assignment, filtering and reporting.
settings.no_positions_description: Positions are the job titles you assign to employees.
settings.no_schedules_description: A schedule defines the working week. Attendance cannot be calculated without one.
settings.no_holidays_description: Holidays are excluded from working days for the whole company.
settings.historical_warning: Changing these values affects how future attendance is calculated. Finalized payroll is never recalculated.
settings.correction_window_days_helper: How many days back an employee may request a correction for. At least 1; the default is 7.
settings.audit_log_description: Every recorded action in your company, newest first.

attendance.matrix_empty_description: Attendance appears here once employees start checking in.

tasks.admin_description: Assign work and follow its progress through checklists.
tasks.my_description: Your assigned work, grouped by what needs attention.
tasks.new_description: Assign work to an employee, with an optional checklist.
tasks.field_department_helper: Filled in from the assignee. You can change it.

tasks.assignee_inactive_hint: Choose an active employee, or reassign the task to someone else.

tasks.reopen_reason_helper: Required. Kept in the task’s history.
tasks.open_items_body: {count} checklist items are still open. Complete the task anyway?

tasks.history_empty: Every change to this task appears here, with who made it and when.
tasks.not_found_description: It may have been deleted, or it is outside what you can see.
tasks.reassignment_description: Open tasks whose assignee is no longer active. Open a task and use Edit to reassign it.
tasks.reassignment_empty: Every open task is assigned to an active employee.
tasks.field_goal_helper: Optional. Only the assignee’s goals can be linked.

dashboard.next_tasks_empty: Nothing is due from today on.
dashboard.welcome_description: Start by checking in. Your tasks and goals will appear here once they are assigned to you.
dashboard.pending_requests_empty: No requests are waiting for your decision.

attachments.hint: PDF, PNG, JPG, WebP, DOCX or XLSX.

goals.title: Goals
goals.admin_description: Targets for employees over a period, and progress toward them.
goals.my_description: Your targets and how far along you are.
goals.empty_description: Create a goal to set a target for an employee over a period.
goals.owner_inactive_hint: Goals can only be set for active employees.
goals.unit_sales_hint: Sales goals are measured in the company currency.
goals.rule_helper: Tasks linked to this goal, assigned to its owner and completed within its period count when their priority is selected. With none selected, every priority counts.
goals.edit_history_note: Changing the target or period never deletes progress history; the earlier target stays on earlier entries.
goals.not_found_description: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.
goals.overlap_warning: This employee already has a goal of the same type in an overlapping period. Both are kept.
goals.misconfigured: No task linked to this goal can count toward it. Link tasks, or check which priorities count.
goals.update_progress_help: Enter the new current value. The previous value stays in the history.
goals.cancel_body: A cancelled goal stays in the record with its history but can no longer be changed.
goals.chart_caption: Each point is progress against the target in effect at the time. The line marks 100%.
goals.linked_tasks_empty: No tasks are linked to this goal.
goals.linked_tasks_empty_task_goal: No tasks are linked yet. Link tasks to this goal for them to count.
goals.record_history_empty: Changes to this goal will appear here.
goals.my_empty_description: Goals your manager sets for you will appear here.

performance.settings_description: How attendance, tasks and goals combine into a performance score. These are your company’s settings, not fixed rules.
performance.historical_warning: New weights apply to scores calculated from now on. Monthly reports already generated keep the weights stored with them, and finalized payroll is not recalculated.
performance.weights_help: Each weight is between 0 and 1, and together they must add up to exactly 1. A component with no data for an employee is left out and the others are scaled up.
performance.weight_helper: Between 0 and 1, up to four decimal places.
performance.attendance_help: Share of scheduled working days attended, minus these points for each late arrival and each absence.
performance.task_help: Completion rate and on-time rate, weighted. The two weights must add up to exactly 1.
performance.sum_blocked: The weights must each add up to exactly 1 before saving.
performance.default_note: These are the default values every company starts with. They have not been changed.

requests.title: Requests
requests.admin_description: Every request from your team in one inbox, pending first.
requests.my_description: Everything you have asked for, and what was decided.
requests.new_description: Choose what you are asking for, then describe it.
requests.inbox_empty_description: There are no pending requests in this category.
requests.filtered_empty_description: Try another status, employee or date range.
requests.my_empty_description: When you ask for something — a salary certificate, help with a task — it appears here with its decision.
requests.task_helper: Optional — one of your own tasks this request is about.
requests.attach_after: You can attach files on the request’s page after you submit it.
requests.submitted_notice: Your request was submitted. It is now pending review.
requests.response_helper: Required when rejecting. The employee sees it.
requests.reason_required: Give a reason for rejecting this request.
requests.cancelled_state: This request was cancelled by the employee.
requests.awaiting_decision: This request is waiting for a decision.
requests.self_review_note: Nobody decides their own request. Another administrator must approve or reject it. If you are the only administrator, it stays pending until another administrator exists; you can still cancel it while it is pending.
requests.cancel_body: It will be withdrawn and nobody will review it. This cannot be undone.
requests.history_empty: Actions on this request will be listed here.
